supersedes.reason: The earlier result exercised a V2 stub. Current V2 models, sessions, mutations, SSE, and reconciliation code was re-executed against real OpenCode.

scenarios.summary: The stale stub failure is superseded: stable auto V2 returned 68 models, 4 agents, and confirmed create/prompt. However, a fresh forced-V2 first catalog query and fresh normal-product auto/V2 catalog queries returned empty before later stable reprobes returned 68. Product-created sessions persisted protocol=legacy through the pool facade, reconciled to unknown, and rejected prompt with HTTP 409. Forced legacy returned 7382 models and confirmed create.
scenarios.supersededFinding: V2 models/create were permanently stubbed as unsupported.
remainingFailures: Fresh-service V2 catalog readiness is racy and can return an authoritative-looking empty array.
The normal server runtime-pool facade does not forward protocol(), so V2 bindings are persisted as legacy.
V2 history/reconcile use limit=1000 where the live message endpoint enforces a maximum of 200.

scenarios.summary: OpenCode 1.18.18 still exposes --mdns advertisement and attach <url>, but no authoritative service descriptor carrying URL, headers, authority, instance, or continuity and no serve --service mode. SDK server declarations expose createOpencodeServer({url, close}), not Service.discover/ensure/stop. No official discovery was fabricated.

With the closest supported injected descriptor seam, real Basic auth succeeded on REST and SSE, missing/wrong/stale credentials returned 401, and header values remained redacted. Official discovery-driven credential rotation remains unavailable.
scenarios.limitation: Both descriptors were injected into Polyth's library seam; this is not OpenCode service-discovery acceptance evidence.

scenarios.summary: The injected seam atomically replaced real URL/auth and generation 1 with generation 2. Continuity was deliberately generation-only because these were different real processes; an old binding failed with stable binding-mismatch before mutation. Official descriptor continuity and delayed active-callback testing remain unavailable.

Library-level borrowed attach operates without spawning. Normal boot still has no borrowed/shared selection: it creates an owned child. When configured with the live shared port, session startup returned 503 generic ServeError instead of attaching; the shared PID remained alive.

Borrowed facade/lifecycle disposal closed only Polyth resources: shared PID 32127 stayed healthy and the independent SSE client remained connected. Normal product boot cannot enter borrowed mode, so product-level shutdown acceptance remains blocked.

A new borrowed lifecycle reconnected to the surviving process and listed the existing sessions, superseding the stale empty-session finding. Hydration and reconciliation both failed HTTP 400 because Polyth requested message limit=1000 instead of the live maximum 200; direct limit=200 history succeeded. There is still no authoritative continuity source and no product attach path.

Native V2 model/agent/session discovery, create/reset, prompt/steer, interrupt, global/session SSE, replay, attachments, and missing permission/question replies reached real /api routes. Fork/delete returned explicit capability-unsupported with no fake success. History and reconcile are broken by limit=1000; facade capabilities still advertise compaction/subagents/attention despite unavailable execution, and fresh catalog calls can return false empty data.

capabilities.startupHealth: pass: real owned and borrowed services reached health; exact owned children stopped on Polyth shutdown; shared PID survived
capabilities.modelsProviders: partial: stable V2=68 models across google/opencode and 4 agents; fresh first calls returned [] in forced V2 and both normal-product runs
capabilities.sessions: partial: create/list/reset pass; history/hydration/reconcile fail HTTP 400 due limit=1000 > 200
capabilities.prompt: adapter pass: prompt admissions confirmed and emitted durable V2 events; normal product fail: session remained unknown and HTTP prompt returned 409
capabilities.streamingReconnect: partial: global stream observed 16 events; session replay returned 15 events and after=2 returned 13; no normal text stream completed
capabilities.toolsThinkingCompleted: not demonstrated: five real Google prompt admissions emitted only admitted/prompted events over 243 seconds; no text, reasoning, tool, or completed event
capabilities.failed: observed: selected opencode model produced session.next.step.failed and native completed assistant error
capabilities.interrupted: not demonstrated: interrupt returned 204/confirmed, but no active executor emitted interrupted evidence
capabilities.attachments: partial: in-root file URI was durably admitted; traversal was silently dropped while the prompt still confirmed instead of rejecting pre-I/O
capabilities.permissionQuestion: partial: native missing-request replies returned explicit 404; no live request was generated because the V2 headless executor did not run
capabilities.forkDelete: pass as negative capability: stable capability-unsupported outcomes, no wire fallback
capabilities.status: partial: native active status returned data {}; Polyth could not derive terminal state because reconciliation failed
capabilities.config: unsupported gap: no /api/config operation; unregistered path fell through to 200 text/html SPA while legacy /config returned JSON
capabilities.waitCompact: explicit upstream 503 ServiceUnavailableError for session.wait and session.compact

remainingProductGaps: Normal boot cannot select a borrowed/shared service.
The server runtime-pool facade omits protocol(), persisting V2 bindings as legacy.
V2 message pagination requests limit=1000 although OpenCode 1.18.18 enforces limit<=200, breaking history, hydrate, and reconcile.
Fresh V2 model/provider discovery is not readiness-stabilized and can return a transient empty catalog as authoritative.
Facade capability flags overclaim compaction, subagents, permissions, and questions.
Traversal attachments are silently omitted rather than rejected.
V2 config absence is not represented by a typed adapter capability; the raw unregistered route is misleading 200 HTML.
No official service discovery/auth/continuity contract exists in 1.18.18.
